'''95,000 BBY''', or '''95,000<ref name="SVC" /> Before the Battle of Yavin''', was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that fell within the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="Era" /> It was thought that the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which was covered by the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], last saw natural light<ref name="SVC" /> from the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Coruscant Prime/Legends|Coruscant Prime]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|148|Coruscant Prime}}</ref> around this [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="SVC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 95,000 BBY was introduced in the "[[In A Galaxy Far, Far Away]]" department of the [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 35|thirty-fifth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection]]'' magazine,<ref name="SVC" /> which was published around [[January 14]], [[2010]].<ref name="Date">{{OSVCdates|35}}</ref>
